components.name: Stamp Button
components.description: Primary order action styled as a pink rubber stamp.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:.85em 1.45em; border-radius:6px; background:#d91566; color:#fff; font-weight:750; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #d91566, inset 0 0 0 4.5px rgba(255,255,255,.6), 0 1px 0 #b30e52, 0 12px 20px -12px rgba(142,11,65,.75); transition:background-color .18s ease-out, transform .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-stamp:hover { background:#b30e52; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-stamp:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-stamp:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2a0f1e; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Line Button
components.description: Secondary action with a printed 2px pink ring.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:48px; padding:.8em 1.2em; border-radius:6px; color:#b30e52; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #b30e52; transition:background-color .18s ease-out, color .18s ease-out; } .ds-btn-line:hover { background:#b30e52; color:#fff; } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2a0f1e; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: App category filter chip in unselected and selected states.
components.css: .ds-chips { display:flex; gap:8px; } .ds-chip { min-height:40px; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:6px; border:1.5px solid #b30e52; background:#fff; color:#2a0f1e; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip.is-on { background:#d91566; border-color:#d91566; color:#fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2a0f1e; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Price Row
components.description: Order-form menu line with tick box, item name and right-aligned tabular price.
components.css: .ds-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:14px 1fr auto; align-items:baseline; gap:12px; padding:11px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(236,28,114,.32); color:#2a0f1e; } .ds-box { width:14px; height:14px; border:1.5px solid #ec1c72; border-radius:2px; } .ds-name { font-weight:550; } .ds-amt { font-size:1.35rem; font-weight:780; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Section Band
components.description: Printed pink category band with an optional butter stamp.
components.css: .ds-band { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:.5em .75em; background:#d91566; color:#fff; font-size:1.02rem; font-weight:750; letter-spacing:.06em; } .ds-mark { padding:.16em .5em; border-radius:4px; background:#fcd04e; color:#2a0f1e; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:800; transform:rotate(-7deg); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #fcd04e, inset 0 0 0 3.5px rgba(42,15,30,.55); }

narrative.overview:
Every Luna surface is a sheet torn from the kiosk's duplicate order booklet. The owner's pink watercolor is the carbon copy underneath; white slips with perforated top edges sit on it; logo pink prints the form, its rules and its column heads; the cashier's handwriting fills in what you are ordering. Prices always sit in one ruled column on the right, the way they do on a real pad, so the eye runs down a single edge to compare them.

The world has three inks plus paper: logo pink, butter yellow and plum-black ink, on white and blush. Pink prints; butter highlights, tapes and stamps; ink reads. Nothing glows and nothing is glass. Depth is paper lying on paper, and every photograph is a snapshot taped to the slip.

The storefront (site/) and the Flutter ordering app (/kiosk/) share the logo, palette, fonts and component language. The storefront is the long, scrolling pad; the app is the same pad at work: the menu is the price board, the cart is the order slip being written, and checkout prints the summary.
keyCharacteristics: The owner's circular Luna logo is the masthead of the first slip and the mark in every header.
White slips with a perforated top edge (16px notch rhythm) on the pink wash.
Pink section bands, pink tick boxes, and a ruled right-hand price column with tabular numerals.
Caveat handwriting only for what is "written in": sample lines, captions, quantities, the close.
Butter yellow as highlighter, tape, offer strip and rubber stamp.

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: If pink carries type, it is Plate Pink with white type. Logo Pink is for rules, marks and type of 24px and up.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Butter Rule
rules.body: Butter never carries white or pink small type; it carries ink.

rules.name: The Print-and-Pen Rule
rules.body: Bricolage prints the form; Caveat writes on it. Caveat never sets a price column, a button, navigation or a paragraph.

rules.name: The One Price Column Rule
rules.body: Amounts align right in one column, in tabular figures, with the ₱ sign once.

rules.name: The Paper-on-Paper Rule
rules.body: Depth is an offset soft cast tinted plum. Never a zero-offset halo or a colored glow.

dos: Do put every type-bearing pink surface on Plate Pink with white text.
Do keep prices in one right-aligned tabular column.
Do use Caveat only for what is written onto a slip: values, sample lines, captions, quantities.
Do keep the delivery-fee notice visible without interaction on the storefront, checkout and receipt.
Do use the owner's logo file (images/luna_logo.png, site/img/luna-logo-*.webp) unaltered apart from its transparent surround.
donts: Don't put white or pink small type on butter, or small type on Logo Pink.
Don't add glows, glass, gradient text or zero-offset halos.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't invent slip numbers, phone numbers, ratings or testimonials to fill the form.
Don't use emoji as icons; use the Material outline set in the app and drawn SVG on the web.
